fields.Name: rasa.io API
fields.Description: rasa.io v2 API client credentials: a client ID and client secret, generated by the customer in the rasa.io dashboard (they replace the v1 API key from the legacy dashboard). The connector exchanges them at POST /v2/tokens (OAuth2 client-credentials grant) for a short-lived JWT presented on every subsequent call. The v1 username/password/API key credential is no longer accepted.
